metrics.description: Flat scalar metrics scored directly against severity bands. Submit 0 for each metric where no violation was found.

model_mixing.description: SC-1: 1 if this type mixes async/await with GCD or completion handlers, 0 if it uses a single concurrency model

orphaned_tasks.description: SC-2: count of Task{}/Task.detached{} calls (excluding SwiftUI .task modifier) with no stored handle or cancellation path

safety_bypasses.description: SC-3: count of @unchecked Sendable on developer-owned types + count of nonisolated(unsafe) usages

independent_sequential_awaits.description: SC-4: count of independent sequential await calls that could be parallelised with async let or TaskGroup

blocking_bridges.description: SC-5: count of sync-to-async blocking patterns (DispatchSemaphore.wait, DispatchGroup.wait, or unnecessary withCheckedContinuation wrapping an available async API)

raw_duration_count.description: SC-6: count of Task.sleep(nanoseconds:) calls or raw integer literals used as time durations where Swift Duration API should be used
